Hawaii Vacation Packing List

Based on your itinerary (June 10-20, 2024), here's what you'll need:

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (for beach days, snorkeling, kayaking)
- Sunscreen (high SPF recommended)
- Hiking gear (for Diamond Head hike on June 13)
- Casual outfits (for daily activities and luau)
- Camera (to capture memories)
- Travel documents (ID, tickets, reservations)

Additional Recommended Items:
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Light rain jacket (for possible showers)
- Reusable water bottle
- Snorkeling gear (optional, can rent at Hanauma Bay)
- Beach towel
- Hat and sunglasses
- Insect repellent
- Formal attire (if needed for any special dinners)
- Chargers for electronic devices
- Small backpack for day trips

Special Notes:
- Spa day on June 17 - consider bringing or purchasing spa-appropriate attire
- Luau on June 16 - consider Hawaiian-style clothing for the experience
- Shopping day on June 19 - leave some space in luggage for souvenirs
